text.title: Laravel Umbrella Procedure
text.summary: 7-step procedure to plan a Laravel feature end-to-end via this umbrella — five operating steps plus two that set the framework wiring up idiomatically.

step.name: route-to-sub-methodologies
step.action: Pick the relevant sub-methodologies: HTTP shape → `php-laravel-patterns`; ORM model touched → `php-eloquent`; queue dispatch → `php-laravel-queues`; new tests → `php-phpunit-testing`.
step.output: List of sub-methodology rules to apply

step.name: enforce-version-and-env
step.action: Confirm `"php": "^8.2"` + Laravel `^10|^11`. Ensure `.env` and `.env.*` are git-ignored. Replace `env(...)` calls inside services with `config(...)` references.
step.decision-gate: If `.env` is tracked, BLOCK per `env-secrets-not-config-cache-leak` rule.

step.name: install-queue-worker
step.action: Set `QUEUE_CONNECTION=redis` for prod. Install Horizon. Create Supervisor program `laravel-worker` with `autostart=true autorestart=true numprocs=4`. Verify with `php artisan queue:monitor`.
step.decision-gate: If `QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync` in prod env, BLOCK per `queue-driver-not-sync-in-prod` rule.

step.name: wire-scheduler
step.action: Add one cron entry `* * * * * cd /srv/app && php artisan schedule:run >> /dev/null 2>&1`. Move per-task cron entries into `schedule()`. Heartbeat ping from a recurring job.

step.name: harden-tests
step.action: Run `php-phpunit-testing` sub-methodology: Pest + `RefreshDatabase`, factories, HTTP feature tests for each endpoint, query budget assertion per request.

step.name: define-contracts-and-provider
step.input: Domain need (mail / payment / storage) + its implementation
step.action: Create the interface under `app/Contracts/` and the implementation under `app/Services/`. Create `<Domain>ServiceProvider` and bind them in `register()`; register the provider. Keep `boot()` for macros, route-model bindings and Blade directives — never `env()` or a DB query.
step.decision-gate: If an `app()->bind(...)` sits outside a provider, BLOCK per `contract-bind-in-provider` rule.

step.name: inject-services-and-wire-middleware
step.input: Services still calling facades + repeated cross-cutting checks
step.action: Replace facade calls inside services with constructor-injected contracts. Move repeated auth / CORS / rate-limit / locale checks into middleware attached to a route group. Convert any route closure to a controller reference, then add `php artisan config:cache && php artisan route:cache` to the deploy script.
step.output: Facade-free services, middleware-owned cross-cutting concerns, cacheable routes and config
step.decision-gate: If a facade remains in a service class, or `route:cache` fails on a closure, BLOCK per `constructor-injection-over-facades` and `routes-in-route-files-only`.
